# LifeOS 3.0

> Offline-first personal life management: Python/SQLite desktop whiteboard, TypeScript/Dexie Pocket PWA, signed-device AutoSync after verified migration, independent Windows archive, manual Google Drive fallback, and Cloudflare Web Push reminders. Latest documentation is on main.

## Documentation
- [AutoSync and Desktop Archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/AUTOSYNC-ARCHIVE.md): independent signed-device sync, retained full history/media, Windows primary archive, migration gate, free resource limits and real-device acceptance boundaries.
- [Simple sync setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/SYNC-SETUP.md): one confirmed source backup per paired phone, automatic contribution/checking/full desktop backup/activation and missing-original troubleshooting.
- [Pre-upgrade rollback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/PRE-AUTOSYNC-ROLLBACK.md): immutable previous release tag and safe code/data recovery.
- [Full business AI access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/FULL-AI-ACCESS.md): opt-in all-date content CRUD, ideas, routines, history, timers and original recording bytes; queue application, version checks and client acceptance limits.
- [Native Remote MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/REMOTE-MCP.md): OAuth connector, limited live projections, queued commands, foreground application, permissions, opt-in read-only daily timing history, Claude setup and honest real-client acceptance boundaries.
- [AI Docs Bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/AI-BRIDGE.md): private Inbox/Context, command protocol, manual review, OAuth setup and a reusable ChatGPT prompt; real-account acceptance is separate from mocks.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/README.md): project overview, system diagram, implementation summary and commands.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): storage, transactions, causal merge, timers, sync and notification boundaries.
- [Release](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/RELEASE-3.0.md): manual sync semantics, verification and current limitations.
- [ChatGPT access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/CHATGPT-ACCESS.md): public links, optional GitHub connection and example questions.
- [Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md): deployment, device authorization and reminder delivery.
- [Parallel timers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZheyuanZeno/lifeos3.0/main/docs/MULTI-TIMER.md): simultaneous routine and plan timers, independent controls, overlap statistics and legacy workflow compatibility.

## Important boundaries
The repository contains source code, not personal LifeOS records or credentials. Google Drive remains manual. Cloudflare AutoSync becomes the default only after verified migration; notification metadata updates remain separate. Reading this repository does not grant access to user data or a write integration. This file is a documentation index, not an automatic permission or discovery mechanism.
